CSIRO Mouse Surveillance

Autumn-2017 Seasonal Summary

Published

April 24, 2026

Overview

This report summarizes house mouse monitoring activities conducted during the Autumn-2017 season across Australian grain-growing regions. Mouse abundance was assessed using three complementary survey methods: live-trapping at benchmark sites, and rapid assessments using chew cards and active burrow counts.

Live-trap Surveys: A total of 592 trap nights (1 trap night = 1 trap set for 1 night) were conducted across 2 benchmark sites in 2 regions spanning 2 states (survey period: March 2017 to March 2017). These surveys captured 145 individual house mice, allowing abundance estimates at these monitoring locations.

Rapid Assessment Surveys: Rapid assessments were conducted across 5 regions using two methods. Chew card surveys deployed 454 cards across 39 sites, with 17.8% showing evidence of mouse activity (81 cards chewed). Active burrow surveys searched 169 transects across 39 sites (survey period: March 2017 to March 2017), detecting active burrows in 43.2% of transects (total: 400 active burrows).
